errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.NO_RESPONSE: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.BAD_RESPONSE: We got an answer we couldn’t read. Try again in a moment.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.LOCKED: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.INVALID_PHONE: Use the full number with the country code, like +91 98450 11234.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL: That email doesn’t look right. Check for a typo.
errors.NAME_REQUIRED: Add your name — your team sees it on everything you change.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: Use at least 10 characters for the password.
errors.PHONE_IN_USE_FOR_SIGN_IN: Change this number under Two-step sign-in, which texts it a code first.
errors.SECOND_FACTOR_REQUIRED: Store owners keep two-step sign-in on.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have access to that.
errors.CODE_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.WRONG_CODE_TRIES: That code doesn’t match. {triesLeft} tries left before sign-in is paused.

signIn.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don’t match. Check them, or reset your password.
signIn.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in timed out. Start again.

code.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Your sign-in timed out. Start again.
code.CODE_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.

products.INVALID_INPUT: Something in this product isn’t valid.
products.CATEGORY_REFUSED: This kind of product can’t be sold here.
products.TOO_MANY_OPTIONS: A product can have up to 3 kinds of choice.
products.TOO_MANY_VERSIONS: A product can have up to 100 versions.
products.OPTION_VALUES_REQUIRED: Every kind of choice needs at least one value.
products.DUPLICATE_OPTION: Two kinds of choice have the same name.
products.DUPLICATE_VALUE: A kind of choice lists the same value twice.
products.VERSION_CHOICES: Press “Update versions” so every version has one value for each kind of choice.
products.DUPLICATE_VERSION: Two versions have the same choices.
products.VERSION_REQUIRED: A product needs at least one version.
products.INVALID_BARCODE: A barcode’s check digit doesn’t match.
products.DUPLICATE_SKU: You already use that product code on another product.
products.TOO_MANY_PHOTOS: A product can have up to 20 photos.
products.INVALID_PHOTO: A photo isn’t valid. Remove it and add it again.
products.FILE_REFUSED: A photo isn’t here any more. Remove it and add it again.
products.INVALID_FILTER: A filter value on this product isn’t one this store has.
products.INVALID_LISTING: Something in the listing sections isn’t valid.
products.LISTING_REFUSED: A related product, badge or size chart isn’t one this product can use.
products.PLAN_LIMIT: Your plan has no room for more products.
products.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: Your plan has no room for more products.
products.NOT_SHOWABLE: This product is waiting for approval, so it can’t be shown yet.
products.STALE_REVISION: Someone else saved this. Reload to see their changes.
products.READ_ONLY: Your store is read-only until the bill is paid.
products.CURRENCY_REQUIRED: Choose the store’s currency in Settings first.
products.BELOW_ZERO: That would take stock below zero.
products.REASON_REQUIRED: Say why, in a few words: the supplier sees it.
products.INVALID_STORY: Something in a module isn’t valid.
products.STORY_REFUSED: A photo, product or brand story here isn’t one this product can use.
products.STORY_INCOMPLETE: Finish the marked modules before publishing.
products.TOO_LARGE: That photo is too big. Use one under 20 MB.
products.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
products.NOT_CONNECTED: This isn’t connected yet. Try again later.

collections.STALE_REVISION: Someone else saved this collection first. Open it again to see their changes.
collections.TOO_MANY_RULES: A collection can have up to 20 rules.
collections.INVALID_RULE: A rule names a filter value that isn’t here any more. Remove it and save again.
collections.TOO_MANY_PRODUCTS: A collection can hold up to 1,000 hand-picked products.
collections.INVALID_PARENT: Choose another collection as the parent — never this one or one inside it.
collections.TOO_MANY_COLLECTIONS: Your store has 500 collections, the most it can have. Delete one first.
collections.NOT_FOUND: This collection isn’t here any more.
collections.READ_ONLY: Your store is read-only until the bill is paid.

filters.DUPLICATE_NAME: Another filter already has that name.
filters.DUPLICATE_VALUE: This filter already has a value with that name.
filters.TOO_MANY_FILTERS: Your store has 200 filters, the most it can have. Merge or remove one first.
filters.INVALID_INPUT: Something here isn’t valid. Values can be up to 60 characters, and a filter up to 200 of them.
filters.NOT_FOUND: That isn’t here any more. It may have been changed elsewhere.
filters.READ_ONLY: Your store is read-only until the bill is paid.
filters.STALE_REVISION: Someone else changed this filter first. It now shows their changes; make yours again.

menus.STALE_REVISION: Someone else changed the menu first. It now shows their version; make your change again.
menus.TOO_MANY_ITEMS: A menu can have up to 100 items.
menus.INVALID_LINK: A menu item links a collection that isn’t here any more. Remove it and try again.
menus.READ_ONLY: Your store is read-only until the bill is paid.

auth.signInSub: Welcome back. Sign in to manage your store.

notice.signedOut: You’re signed out of every store on this device.
notice.expired: You were signed out after a while without activity. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
notice.noStores: This account doesn’t belong to a store here. Ask the store’s owner to invite you.

auth.twoStepApp: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.resendWait: Didn’t get it? You can ask again in {seconds}s.
auth.codeLength: The code has 6 digits — check it again.
auth.backupSub: One of the 10 codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in, like K4P2-9XQM. Each works once.
auth.backupInvalid: That doesn’t look like a backup code — it’s 8 letters and numbers, like K4P2-9XQM.
auth.enrolPhoneSub: Store owners need it before the store opens — it protects your payouts and your customers’ data. We’ll text you a code each time you sign in.
auth.enrolCodeSub: Type the 6-digit code we texted to {hint}.
auth.codesSub: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. We won’t show them again.
auth.forgotSub: Type the email you sign in with. We’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotEmailInvalid: Type the email address you sign in with.
auth.forgotSentSub: If {email} has an account, a link to reset the password is on its way. It works for 30 minutes. Open it in your browser, choose a new password, then sign in here.
auth.lockedSub: There were 5 wrong passwords or codes in a row, so we paused sign-in for {minutes} minutes to keep your store safe. We’ve emailed the account owner. Reset your password to get back in now.
auth.chooseSub: Signed in as {email}. You belong to {count} stores — pick one to open.
auth.chooseRemoved: You no longer have access to {store} — its owner removed you. Your other stores still work.
auth.signOutBody: Signs you out of every store on this device.

profile.title: My profile
profile.sub: One account for every store you belong to. Changes here apply everywhere you sign in.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHelpChanged: We’ll send a link to the new address. It changes once you click it.
profile.emailSent: We sent a link to {email} — your email changes once you click it.
profile.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
profile.passwordNote: Changing it signs you out on every other device.
profile.passwordShort: The new password needs at least 10 characters.
profile.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords don’t match.
profile.passwordDone: Password changed — you’re signed out everywhere else.
profile.twoStepWhyOwner: Required for store owners — it protects your payouts and customer data. You can change how you get codes, but not turn it off.
profile.twoStepWhyOther: Optional for your role, and strongly recommended. Each sign-in asks for a code as well as your password.
profile.methodAppSub: Codes come from the app on your phone. Works without signal.
profile.methodSmsSub: Codes are texted to your mobile number.
profile.backupSoon: {count} of 10 backup codes left — make new ones soon
profile.newCodesBody: Your old codes stop working straight away.
profile.turnOffBody: Anyone with your password could then sign in as you.
profile.pickTitle: How do you want to get your codes?
profile.pickSmsSub: To the mobile number in Your details
profile.pickSmsNone: Add a mobile number in Your details first
profile.verifyAppTitle: Add this account to your authenticator app, then type the code it shows
profile.setupKey: Setup key — type it into Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or similar
profile.codesSub: If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once. We won’t show them again.
profile.signOutOthersBody: Every other device is signed out. This one stays signed in.

provisioning.title: Your store is being built —
provisioning.body: about a minute. Products work now; Storefront and Settings open when it’s ready.

pastDue.title: Your store is view-only.
pastDue.body: Your last payment didn’t go through. Everything is safe — pay in the web portal to start editing again.

trial.title: Free trial · {days}.
trial.body: You have everything while it lasts. No card needed.

trialEnding.title: Your trial ends tomorrow.
trialEnding.body: Choose a plan in the web portal to keep everything, or pick what to keep on the free plan.

trialEnded.title: Your trial ended — you’re on the free plan.
trialEnded.body: Items over the free plan’s limits are paused, never deleted.

bandwidth.title: You’ve used {percent}% of this month’s bandwidth.

whiteLabel.title: White-label is on.
whiteLabel.body: Your customers see your own name everywhere — not DripFunnel.

suspended.title: This store is suspended.
suspended.body: Nothing can be changed and the shop shows a notice. {contact}
suspended.noContact: Contact your store’s provider to find out why.

cancelled.title: This store is cancelled.
cancelled.body: You can look around and export until the paid period ends.

collections.title: Collections
collections.sub: Groups of products shown together on your store, like “Summer Sale” or “Men’s Shirts”.
collections.viewOnly: You can look at collections but not change them.

empty.title: Group your products
empty.body: Collections become the pages and menu links of your shop — “Summer Sale”, “Gifts under {price}”, “Men’s Shirts”. Pick products by hand, or let them fill themselves.
empty.bodyNoPrice: Collections become the pages and menu links of your shop — “Summer Sale”, “Gifts”, “Men’s Shirts”. Pick products by hand, or let them fill themselves.

editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionHint: Shown at the top of the collection page
editor.automaticSub: Every product matching your rules — new ones join by themselves
editor.priceNote: “Price is under …” isn’t possible yet. With several currencies it would use your pricing currency ({currency}).
editor.priceNoteNoCurrency: “Price is under …” isn’t possible yet. With several currencies it would use your pricing currency.

kept.one: 1 more rule this screen doesn’t change is kept as it is.
kept.other: {count} more rules this screen doesn’t change are kept as they are.

editor.noPicks: No products picked yet. Search below and tick the ones to add.

pickedSoFar.one: 1 product picked so far. Tap one to take it out.
pickedSoFar.other: {count} products picked so far. Tap one to take it out.

editor.inherit: Only show products that are also in {name}
editor.hidden: Hidden — for offers or internal use
editor.noMatch: No products match yet. Try “any of these rules”, or pick more values.
editor.previewFailed: The preview didn’t load. Your rules are kept; it tries again when you change one.

deleteBody.one: The 1 product stays in your catalogue — only the group goes.
deleteBody.other: The {count} products stay in your catalogue — only the group goes.

editor.deleteMenu: It’s in your menu too; we’ll take it out and move anything nested under it up a level.
editor.deleteMenuMaybe: If it’s in your menu, we’ll take it out and move anything nested under it up a level.

filters.title: Filters
filters.sub: The checkboxes shoppers see on the left of your shop.
filters.viewOnly: You can look at filters but not change them.
filters.none: No filters yet. Create one — Fabric, Occasion or Fit — and add its values.
filters.newBody: Suggestions: Brand · Fabric · Occasion · Fit · Pattern. It shows in your shop’s filters once it has values.
filters.makeInternal: {name}: shoppers see this. Make it internal
filters.makeShopper: {name}: only you see these. Show it to shoppers
filters.makeInternalBody: Shoppers will no longer see {name} as a filter on your shop. Only your team sees it, and automatic collections keep using it.
filters.makeShopperBody: {name} will appear as a filter on your shop, with its values.
filters.nowInternal: {name} is now internal — only you see it

uses.one: 1 product uses it. Renaming keeps it; deleting takes it off.
uses.other: {count} products use it. Renaming keeps them all; deleting takes it off them.

deleteBody.one: 1 product loses it, and automatic collections using it will shrink.
deleteBody.other: {count} products lose it, and automatic collections using it will shrink.

filters.lookAlike: “{a}” and “{b}” look like the same thing.
filters.choices: the shopper picks one when buying, like Size M. Each has its own price and stock. Set them on the product.
filters.filtersText: the shopper ticks boxes to narrow down, like Fabric: Linen. Nothing to pick at checkout.
filters.tags: only you see them, like “Reorder soon”.
filters.tip: Tap a value to rename or delete it. Filters also power automatic collections.

menus.title: Main menu
menus.note: Tap an item to move, nest or remove it. Hidden collections stay here but shoppers don’t see them.
menus.viewOnly: You can look at the menu but not change it. Hidden collections stay here but shoppers don’t see them.
menus.addLabel: Add a collection to the menu
menus.removed: Removed from the menu. The collection is still there.
menus.removeBody: The collection stays in your catalogue. Anything nested under it moves up a level.
menus.actionsSub: What to do with this item
menus.firstNest: The first item can’t be nested
menus.nestHasKids: An item with items under it can’t be nested — the menu goes one level deep. Move its items out first.
menus.empty: No items yet. Add a collection to start your menu.

loadFailed.title: Your menu didn’t load
loadFailed.body: Check your connection and try again.

search.label: Search products
search.placeholder: Search by name or product code

waiting.one: {count} supplier product is waiting for your approval.
waiting.other: {count} supplier products are waiting for your approval.

banner.waitingBody: They go live once you approve them.
banner.sentBack: Sent back by your store owner:
banner.sentBackBody: “{reason}” Fix it and send it again.
banner.theirsBody: They will see your changes. You decide the price and whether it shows on your store.
banner.ownerToo: Your store owner can also edit this product.
banner.ownerTooApproval: Changes to the price, name or photos wait for their approval.
banner.ownerTooLive: Changes you save go live straight away.
banner.stockOnlyBody: Your store owner manages everything else about this product.
banner.viewOnlyBody: Editing is for owners and managers.
banner.readOnly: Your store is read-only until the bill is paid.
banner.readOnlyBody: You can look, but nothing can be changed.
banner.approval: Your store owner approves this before it goes live.
banner.kind: This kind of product is edited on the web for now.
banner.kindBody: Downloads, services and gift cards aren’t in the app yet. You can still look at it here.
banner.failed: Couldn’t save — your changes are still here.
banner.staleBody: Reload to see their changes; yours are still on this page until you do.

fix.one: 1 thing needs fixing before you save:
fix.other: {count} things need fixing before you save:

problem.name: Give the product a name.
problem.compare: The compare-at price has to be higher than the price.
problem.cost: Check what it costs you: type a number.
problem.options: Every kind of choice needs a name and at least one choice.
problem.versions: Press “Create versions” or “Update versions” so each combination has its own version.
problem.tooMany: That makes more than 100 versions. Remove a few choices.
problem.stock: A count has to be a whole number, 0 or more.
problem.photosBusy: A photo is still uploading. Save again once it’s in.

noResults.body: Check the spelling, or clear your search and filters.

empty.title: Add your first product
empty.body: A photo, a name and a price is enough to start selling. You can add sizes, colours and the rest whenever you like.

supplierEmpty.title: No products yet
supplierEmpty.body: Add your first product. The store owner reviews it before it goes on sale.

review.title: Review · from {supplier}
review.note: You set the price and can change it after approving
review.approved: “{name}” approved and live. {supplier} has been told.
review.sendBackBody: Say what needs changing. They’ll see exactly what you write.
review.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The main photo is blurry — please upload a sharper one.
review.reasonMissing: Add a reason so they know what to fix

saved.submitted: Sent to your store owner for approval
saved.needsApproval: Your price, title or photo change needs approval

bar.failed: Couldn’t save — your changes are still here

free.title: Selling for free?
free.body: That’s fine for a gift or a freebie — just checking it isn’t a typo.

photos.title: Photos
photos.altHint: Helps blind shoppers and Google. Say what the photo shows.
photos.help: The first photo is the one shoppers see in lists. Square photos look best. iPhone photos are converted for you.
photos.helpNone: Products with a photo sell far better. On a phone you can take one now.
photos.limit: That’s the most photos a product can have.
photos.cameraDenied: The camera isn’t allowed. Turn it on for this app in your phone’s settings, or choose a photo instead.

details.title: Details
details.name: Product name
details.namePlaceholder: What a shopper would type to find it, e.g. Organic Cotton Tee
details.descriptionPlaceholder: What makes it special? What’s it made of? How does it fit?

visibility.visibleSub: Shoppers can find and buy it
visibility.hiddenSub: Only you and your team can see it

price.title: Price
price.missing: Add a price above zero so shoppers can buy this
price.compareLow: The compare-at price has to be higher than the price
price.compareHelp: Show a crossed-out price only when it was really sold for that before.
price.none: What the shopper pays. Tax is worked out at checkout.

choices.ask: Does it come in different sizes, colours or other choices?
choices.askSub: e.g. Size: S, M, L · Colour: Sand, Ink. Each combination gets its own price.
choices.title: Choices
choices.kindName: Name of this kind of choice
choices.valuePlaceholder: Type a choice, or several with commas
choices.upToThree: Up to 3 kinds of choice per product

needTitle.one: Your 1 version needs a {name}. Which is it?
needTitle.other: Your {count} versions need a {name}. Which is it?

choices.needBody: Tell us what the versions you already have are. You can add the other choices after.
choices.addedUpdate: Added {name}. Press “Update versions” to create its versions.
choices.addChoicesFirst: Add at least one choice to each kind.

newOnes.one: 1 new version to create — pre-filled from the first one.
newOnes.other: {count} new versions to create — pre-filled from the first one.

ready.one: 1 version ready — set its price below
ready.other: {count} versions ready — set prices and counts below

choices.tooMany: That makes {count} versions — a product allows 100. Remove a few choices or split this into two products.
choices.cantUndo: This can’t be undone. Past orders keep their record.
choices.removeKindBody: Versions merge. For each remaining combination we keep the first version’s price and add the counts together. Past orders keep their record.

versions.title: Versions · {count}
versions.setPriceTitle: Set the price of every version
versions.setGroupTitle: Set the price of every {group} version
versions.notMade: We don’t make this · Add back
versions.hidesAllBody: The product would say “Visible” but shoppers couldn’t buy anything. Hide the whole product instead?
versions.notMakeBody: Hide it (you still sell the other versions), or say you don’t make this combination?
versions.notMakeSub: Removes the combination — add it back any time
versions.help: Tap “Visible” to hide one version. “We don’t make this” removes a combination — add it back any time.

stock.title: Stock
stock.help: How many you have ready to sell. We count down as orders come in.
stock.untracked: Not tracked for this kind of product.
stock.noWarehouse: There is no location to count stock in yet. Add one on the web.
stock.label: Stock of {name} at {warehouse}

reserved.one: {count} reserved for orders · sold, not shipped yet.
reserved.other: {count} reserved for orders · sold, not shipped yet.

stock.adjustBody: {name}: shown in the stock history, so everyone knows why the number moved. It is saved right away, apart from the rest of the product.
stock.adjustCount: How many? Use − to remove, e.g. −2
stock.historyNote: Every change is kept — by hand, by orders, by suppliers and by imports.
stock.failed: The product saved, but the counts didn’t. Try saving again.
stock.newFailed: The product saved, but its counts didn’t. Open it and count the stock again.

aplus.title: A+ content · Product story
aplus.summary: Big photos and feature blocks below your product
aplus.plan: A+ content isn’t on your plan.
aplus.saveFirst: Save the product first, then add its A+ content.
aplus.saveChangesFirst: Save your changes first, then open its A+ content.

ready.title: Ready to sell in
ready.afterSave: Shown once the product is saved.
ready.note: Missing details only stop sales in that country.
ready.onWeb: Details like fibre content and care are added on the web for now.

refused.VERSION_CHOICES: Press “Update versions” so every version has one value for each kind of choice.

story.title: Headline

state.changed: Draft has changes · live page unchanged
state.draft: Draft · not on your store yet

story.videoOff: Video is switched off in Settings › Catalogue
story.templateBody: Your current modules will be swapped out. Nothing is published until you publish.
story.templateAdded: {name} template added — fill in each module
story.copySearch: Find the product to copy from
story.copyBody: This product’s draft is replaced with that one’s. Its live page doesn’t change until you publish.
story.copied: Copied — change anything that’s different for this product
story.empty: Add a module, or start from a template. Shoppers see this below your product description.
story.tooMany: {max} modules is the most a product can have — remove one to add another
story.altHint: Required — shoppers using screen readers hear this
story.compareNote: Rows come from each product’s Specifications — never retyped.
story.brandEmpty: No brand stories yet. They are made in Settings › Catalogue and shown on every product that uses them.
story.brandSupplier: Brand stories are your store owner’s.
story.brandFailed: We couldn’t load your brand stories. Try again in a moment.
story.fromProduct: Shows this product’s {what}, as they are in the editor.

gaps.one: 1 thing to fill in before publishing — it’s marked.
gaps.other: {count} things to fill in before publishing — they’re marked.

story.saved: Draft saved — your live page hasn’t changed
story.published: A+ content is live on your product page
story.submitted: Sent for approval with the product
story.viewOnly: You can look at A+ content but not change it.
story.readOnly: Your store is read-only until the bill is paid — nothing can be published.
story.waitUpload: A photo is still uploading. Save again once it’s in.

states.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Your data is safe — we’re still loading it.

loadErr.title: We couldn’t load {name}
loadErr.body: Nothing is lost — this is a problem on our side, not your data. It usually clears in a few seconds.
loadErr.ref: Ref 503 · {ref} — quote this if you contact support

notFound.label: this page
notFound.title: This page isn’t here any more
notFound.body: The link may be old, or what it pointed to was deleted or moved. Nothing else in your store has changed.

denied.title: You don’t have access to {name}
denied.body: Your role can’t open {name}. Ask the store’s owner if you need it.
denied.bodySupplier: Your supplier access can’t open {name}. Ask {store} if you need it.

offline.body: Check your connection. What you’ve already opened stays here — changes need a connection.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.note: Development builds only. Picks what the shell draws so each state can be checked without a store in it.
